payload.name: Optimized Routes Sit Beside the Sequential Path
payload.description: A faster route for capable hardware is added next to the sequential one and chosen by configuration. It must give the same output and must not skip something the sequence relied on.

principles.name: Both paths stay
principles.description: Local or constrained setups still need the sequential path; the optimization is an extra, not a replacement.

principles.name: Order can be load bearing
principles.description: A call that awaited another may have needed its result, so concurrency has to be proven safe.

heuristics.condition: many small host calls are made one after another on fresh connections
heuristics.action: share one client and run them concurrently only after the independence proof
look for the thing that wait was protecting before accepting the change

decision_rules.name: Keep both routes
decision_rules.condition: a concurrent, batched or otherwise faster route is introduced
decision_rules.outcome: keep the existing sequential route and select between them by configuration, with the optimized route documented as an option for capable hardware

decision_rules.name: Prove independence
decision_rules.outcome: show for each call that it does not read what another produces or depend on its ordering, and keep the original order for results

decision_rules.name: Identical output
decision_rules.outcome: check that the same input gives the same output as the sequential route on real data before it is the configured default

decision_rules.name: Watchdogs follow progress
decision_rules.condition: a long step is guarded by a time watchdog
decision_rules.outcome: reset the watchdog on each real progress event instead of a single fixed deadline
